purpose: Test whether a single fixed image crop before the initial YOLO box changes subsequent Lean propagation in selected failure cases; examine the sequence 23 inset error.
scope: Four previously inspected sequences seq8, seq11, seq20, seq23. Retrospective exploratory diagnostic, not a deployable automatic viewport selector or independent evaluation.
inputs: Keep the original first detection frame from the existing automatically initialized run. At that same frame, use the precomputed YOLO box produced on the right two-thirds of the image (x begins at floor(width/3)); translate the coordinates back to the full image. YOLO's existing weights and confidence/NMS settings are unchanged. Every selected frame has a crop box; the experiment stops if that condition fails. No ground-truth mask or label enters inference.
limitations: The fixed crop was chosen after observing the sequence 23 picture-in-picture error. It is not learned, is not a general viewport detector, and may cut real targets, as observed in seq8. The original first detection time is held fixed to isolate changing the initial box; this is not an end-to-end evaluation of a crop-based detector schedule. Original YOLO boxes must already exist; no video re-detection or temporal gate is added. No new confidence threshold is introduced.
model: SAM2 receives the full original image and the mapped crop box; apply original early-FPN point selection, automatic refined-mask initialization and the same Lean and pooled-grid anchor settings. Propagate the full original video without re-detection.
controls: The saved existing automatic combined predictions on the same video and first prompt index; historical GT-mask native and Lean scores are descriptive only.
verification: First run two independent label-free first-frame seq23 predictor checks: exact saved original prompt replay and exact independent crop prompt replay. Require two independent full-video no-op seq3 replays to match all archived masks and retained-token records. Independently repeat one changed-prompt seq23 full video. Score all masks only after video inference, then independently verify every output mask and label hash. Record source, detector, crop boxes, coordinates, and model parameter hashes.
interpretation: Do not choose this or another crop from these outcomes. Assess present-frame Dice and false alarms for every selected case, especially whether any apparent seq23 gain damages seq8. This cannot establish generalization or meet the full 21-sequence retention objective.
